name: Genotypes · Potions
description: Two ways to write a creature's genes into your body: the $(reset)permanent potion$(reset) (genotype absorption) and the $(reset)breakthrough potion$(reset) (temporary awakening) — breakthrough splits into three directions: Balance / Surge / Endure, alongside the gene manager and rejection serum.$(br)Reading order: $(reset)Genotype Potions Guide$(reset) first, then the recipe data in $(reset)Three Breakthrough Modes$(reset).
